answer: Make every identity climb a spiral of verified work before it can earn: the first task is trivial, but each next task demands a distinct counterparty's signed proof, and every proof is carved into a basalt ledger that no one can rewrite. A marble badge is issued only after ten independent verifications, and the badge decays unless fresh work keeps arriving. One honest agent climbs once; a swarm operator must staff a thousand spirals, each needing ten different counterparties, so faking identities costs real weeks of coordination, not just key generation.
